newsitem.title: UK: BFI falls 12 to 1,481, inquiry is thin.
newsitem.headline: BFI falls 12 to 1,481, inquiry is thin.

text.p: The spot BFI fell 12 points on Thursday to 1,281, reflecting a gloomy view of the market, although the few Atlantic Panamax fixtures reported were at reasonably steady levels.
Brokers said the loading problems in the Mississippi, the delays in Paranagua and Vancouver, as well as the absence of fresh chartering enquiry have all dampened prospects in grain trades.
South Korean charterers were rumoured to have fixed a prompt stem of 54,000 tonnes heavy grain U.S. Gulf/Japan at a weaker $24 no combo.
Navix fixed Northern Princess 71,000 dwt delivery Taiwan April 10 trip via Eastern Australia to Japan on subjects at a lower level of $12,350 daily.
The Baltic Handy Index was down five at 1,102, they added.
